definitions.explanation: Skilled work done by hand, especially detailed or delicate work on objects. Also refers to the finished product of such work.
A clever or underhanded manipulation, tampering, or scheming done to achieve a desired outcome.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{細工|さいく}だ。
{金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{細工|さいく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}された→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a box with gold filigree work on it.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a standalone noun and in compounds. In sense 2, often appears with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to mean "to tamper with" or "to manipulate." The compound {小|こ}{細工|ざいく} (petty tricks) is very common and has a strongly negative connotation. Note the rendaku: さいく → ざいく in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細工|さいく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧: finely crafted
- {細工|さいく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧: to apply craftsmanship
- {細工|さいく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tamper with, to manipulate
- {小|こ}{細工|ざいく}: petty tricks, cheap tricks
- {竹|たけ}{細工|ざいく}: bamboo craft
- {金|きん}{細工|ざいく}: goldsmithing
